meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会把内容做成一套可翻页的幻灯片演示文稿,包含幻灯片、片段揭示、热点跳转、分支页和演讲者备注,产出可演示的网页 deck,而不是渲染成 MP4 视频;若你没明确要求做幻灯片,它会先向你确认再动手。
howto.when: 当你明确说“幻灯片 / slide show / HyperFrames slideshow”时直接制作;当你提到“演示文稿 / pitch deck / 把网页转成幻灯片”等相近请求时,它会先确认再开始。

say.text: 把这份产品介绍做成幻灯片演示
say.note: 触发 slideshow 技能,生成可导航的 deck。

say.text: 把我的落地页转成可交互的幻灯片
say.note: 会先确认再转换,尽量保留原页面效果。

say.text: 给这套 deck 加上演讲者备注
say.note: 会把备注写入幻灯片的数据清单中。

howto.what_en: Turns content into a navigable HyperFrames deck with slides, fragments, branching, hotspots, and presenter notes; outputs a runnable deck, not an MP4, and confirms before authoring unless explicitly asked.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, slide show, or HyperFrames slideshow; for adjacent requests like presentation, pitch deck, or converting a page, Claude pauses to confirm first.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a slide deck.
Convert my landing page into an interactive slideshow.
Add speaker notes to this deck.
